name: Plague Lust
source:
An unknown virus has destroyed most of humanity, leaving behind ruined streets, dangerous scavenging runs, and a mansion that slowly becomes your new center of survival. By day, you manage the house, explore new locations, talk to the girls, complete quests, and gather the resources needed to keep everyone alive. 

[From [url=https://nanilust.itch.io/plaguelust]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一种未知的病毒摧毁了大部分人类，留下了毁坏的街道、危险的拾荒路线，以及一座慢慢成为你新的生存中心​​的豪宅。白天，你管理房子，探索新地点，与女孩们交谈，完成任务，并收集维持每个人生存所需的资源。

[来自[url=https://nanilust.itch.io/plaguelust]itch.io[/url]]
